external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Between 1977 and 1998, Twin/Tone released over 300 records. During those years we worked with over 180 bands and 20 indie labels. We helped more than 25 of the bands go on to work with major labels.

Slim Dunlap's two obscure yet adored mid-90's solo albums The New Old Me & Times Like This have been remastered and lovingly packaged on a new double-CD entitled EVERY LITTLE WORD. In full cooperation with Slim's family and Medium Cool /Twin Tone Records imprint especially for Curation Records.
